task: Measure expression text lookups while migrating checker recursion from strings to retained EST nodes.
observation: The existing MOSS_EST_TEXT_NODE_LOOKUPS counter reported zero on functional_basics.moss and specialized_call_facts.moss, but adding counters at EST-view and text-keyed parse-cache lookups measured 16,593 and 26,775 consultations respectively. The earlier metric therefore did not describe checker text-cache use.
impact: The initial K2 progress signal was materially incomplete; the new counter exposed the checker cache debt and enabled focused before/after measurements while node-based paths are migrated.

resolution.summary: Added opt-in test-build counts for EST-view and text-keyed parse cache consultations. The counters are now available, but K2 is still open because the checker continues to consult these caches.
